description: This Java class, ImageManagementHelper, provides utility methods for retrieving internal image URLs associated with products in the OFBiz framework. It interacts with the database via entity queries to obtain product image information, with a focus on default images and approved images.

classes.name: ImageManagementHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manage product image URLs within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getInternalImageUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the internal URL of the default or approved product image based on provided product ID from the HTTP request context.
